payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP over integer values up to 1e5: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + freq[i]*i), typical house-robber pattern.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 1D array dp (size 1e5+1) where state i depends on i-1 and i-2. This matches dp_1d_state exactly; no 2D, tree, interval, etc.
